description: Use this first when deciding whether a business has recoverable missed-call or follow-up revenue leakage. Returns a score, estimated monthly leak, recoverable revenue, and next action. Execution costs $0.005 via x402 Base USDC.

averageJobValue.description: Average revenue in USD from one won job or customer opportunity.

businessName.description: Optional business name used only to label the result.

estimatedRecoveryRate.description: Expected fraction of leaked opportunities that can be recovered, from 0 to 1. Omit to use the model default.

industry.description: Business industry or service category, for example HVAC, roofing, plumbing, legal, or dental.

missedCallsPerWeek.description: Estimated inbound calls missed per week. Use 0 when none are missed.

zipCode.description: Optional postal code used as business-market context.

name: inspect_revenue_opportunity
title: Inspect Revenue Opportunity
